svg.title: Robot Air Hockey testbed
svg.desc: Top-down air hockey table. In a 2D simulator the paddle strikes a moving puck into a goal region; in a 3D simulator a robot arm hits the puck into a block; on the real UR5e an overhead camera tracks the puck while the robot juggles it on the tilted table. The same ten tasks and interface are used to benchmark behavior cloning, offline RL (IQL) and online RL.

g.text: Dynamic task: strike a moving puck into a goal
Same task interface in a 3D robot simulator
Real UR5e: an overhead camera tracks the puck
Benchmark BC, offline RL and online RL
